description: React component for managing push notification settings in Mattermost admin console, including server type, location, and related configurations.

classes.name: PushSettings
classes.description: React component extending OLDAdminSettings to configure push notification settings in Mattermost.

methods.name: canSave
methods.description: Determines if the current settings can be saved based on server type and agreement.

methods.name: handleAgreeChange
methods.description: Handles change event for the agreement checkbox.

methods.name: handleDropdownChange
methods.description: Handles change events for dropdown selections related to server type and location.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Generates configuration object from current component state.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state based on provided configuration.

methods.name: isPushNotificationServerSetByEnv
methods.description: Checks if push notification server settings are set via environment variables.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title for the push notification settings section.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the settings UI for push notification configuration, including server type, location, and notification thresholds.
